review_prompts: Does the matrix enumerate every indexed v0.92 feature and required supporting critical path exactly once?
Does each accepted row independently prove repository identity, implementation, review, merge, ancestry, validation, negative, integration, platform, and typed-terminal truth?
Do the validator and negative suite reject every prohibited evidence class without accepting self-attested JSON?
Does any unresolved blocker incorrectly unlock WP-23, WP-25, or a release claim?
Are all changed paths within #311 ownership and all dependency work read-only?

findings.summary: Accepted evidence was reusable across unrelated feature and critical-path rows without proving the reviewed contract or owner binding.
The accepted path did not sufficiently bind the canonical typed index, review assignment, reviewer, revision, and SOR authority.
Live GitHub validation omitted issue closure and required-check GitHub App identity.
The complete packet did not fully bind lane uniqueness, log digests, exact denominator identity, blocker reasons, and the WP-21A source revision.
Execution evidence had not consumed #310 terminal reconciliation and cleanup as the approved hard prerequisite.
